name: Private Playback
description: An unofficial Jellyfin plugin providing configurable per-user playback privacy. It can prevent selected playback state such as resume progress, watched state and playback history from being persisted.
overview: Per-user private playback policies for Jellyfin.

versions.changelog: Initial beta release for Jellyfin 10.11.11 with per-user privacy policies, server-side playback-state protection, existing-data cleanup and nine dashboard localisations.
